messages:
lina: Heads-up — I'm landing a tweak to infra CI that changes the infra pipeline ordering. plan -> apply -> then we trigger ArgoCD sync from CI. Need quick eyeballs on secrets wiring + ordering so we don't double-apply or leave apps out-of-sync. Diff: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/842

matt: can you paste the GH Actions job you're adding? curious how you trigger argocd and whether the runner talks to the cluster.

lina: here's the trimmed job:
```yaml
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: atlantis-plan
        run: atlantis plan --dir=envs/staging
  apply:
    needs: [plan]
    steps:
      - name: atlantis-apply
        run: atlantis apply --dir=envs/staging
  trigger-argocd-sync:
    needs: [apply]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: trigger-argocd
        run: |
          gh api repos/redwood/argocd-webhook/dispatches -f ref=main -F event_type=infra-sync
```

alex: we generally avoid GH runners calling cluster APIs directly. Better to let ArgoCD detect the repo change or trigger via repo webhook. Also make sure we wait for atlantis apply to finish applying resources before telling argocd to sync — apply can be async if hooks are involved.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: atlantis apply succeeded for PR #842 (envs/staging) — duration 21s.

ashley: main risk is SOPS-encrypted secrets. If ArgoCD's repo-server can't decrypt during render, the app will show degraded health. Do we have the sops plugin enabled for the repo-server in staging?

matt: if argocd can't decrypt, we can't rely on it to materialize secret objects. I don't want GH runners holding cluster creds to apply secrets.

lina: proposal: keep atlantis apply as-is, trigger ArgoCD via repo webhook (no direct cluster talk), then have the GH job poll ArgoCD API for app status and only mark CI as done when app.health == "Healthy" and sync.status == "Synced" (with a timeout). That avoids giving runners cluster permissions.

alex: +1. Also add a small guard: only trigger sync for affected apps (detect changed paths) so we don't noisy-sync everything. And include a short wait-loop in the job: poll every 10s up to 5m.

ashley: I can add a repo-server plugin config to our argocd Helm values in staging to enable sops decryption (uses KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/abcd). I'll test in staging first and post results.

lina: thanks — also pinging reviewers: I added an atlantis.yaml snippet to require `apply_requirements: [mergeable]` for infra dirs. Please confirm that won't block legitimate hotfixes.

matt: SGTM for the policy, but add a comment about the maintenance window and manual-apply exemption for emergency ops.

infra-bot: ci-check: gha-runner concurrency for "infra" queue is currently 2/5. If apply jobs back up they will queue — consider increasing runner concurrency or using dedicated runners for infra applies.
